description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/create-w-accdb and r-fmt-2-pres-1/create-world-accdb: the Decimal columns Fx.Fm and Sc.Fm were appended with DAO TableDef.CreateField(name, 20), which gives Precision 38 and Scale 0; DAO Field.Value then fails on every non-Null value (3000, -1038) and the writes of the scalar-admission probe were refused (0x800A0EAF). Fixture (ACCDB), CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128): the Nums helper (1..1024); Fx exactly as in r-fmt-2b (ten rows, ID Long key, Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, Text Vt, row 8 Null in all fixed fields, GUIDs written through a table recordset); Sc2(ID Long key) and Dt(ID Long key, Ft Date). On the closed file ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) adds Fx.Fm as DECIMAL(28,0) and Sc2.Fm as DECIMAL(18,4); DAO then sets Fx.Fm = ID * 100 with SQL integer literals for every row except 8. Asks what DAO reports for both Decimal fields (Type, Size, Attributes, Precision and Scale) and what DAO and SQL CStr(Fm) read back. The closed file is kept.
